name: caelo
description: Edit a Caelo CMS site from Claude Code: connect by URL and sign in with Google, plus skills to edit safely (draft, stage, a person publishes) and hand a prototype over to Caelo. For installs without remote MCP use caelo-token.

mcp_url.title: Caelo MCP URL (Power-MCP)
mcp_url.description: The Power-MCP URL your Caelo site shows under Settings → MCP, ending in /api/mcp/power. After saving, run /mcp, pick caelo and sign in with your Google account. Your site shows no such URL? Install caelo-token instead.
